title: 我的旅程，你的未來
footer: Teacher Dom · My Journey, Your Future 我的旅程，你的未來

slides.eyebrow_zh: 國中部 807 班雙語課程

strip.zh: 807 班：田中馬拉松啦啦隊冠軍

strip.en: the season of The Amazing Race Dom raced in
strip.zh: Dom 參加的《驚險大挑戰》季數

lines.en: I have been teaching students in Taiwan for a couple of years.
lines.zh: 我在台灣教學生已經有幾年了。

lines.en: Today: my journey, and your future.
lines.zh: 今天的主題：我的旅程，和你的未來。

slides.ask_en: Today's question: can where you start decide where you go?
slides.ask_zh: 今天的問題：你從哪裡出發，能決定你會走到哪裡嗎？

slides.ask_en: My journey started 11,000 km from here. Today, let's think about where YOUR journey can go.
slides.ask_zh: 我的旅程從一萬一千公里外開始。今天，我們來想想你的旅程可以走到哪裡。

prompts.en: Stand up if you cheered at the Tianzhong Marathon this year.
prompts.zh: 今年有在田中馬拉松加油的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you tried something new, even though you were scared.
prompts.zh: 曾經害怕、但還是試了新事物的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have talked with someone from another country.
prompts.zh: 跟外國人說過話的，站起來。

slides.punch_en: Cheering, courage, connecting: that is what today is all about.
slides.punch_zh: 加油、勇氣、連結——這就是今天的全部。

slides.body_en: I grew up in Compton, a city near Los Angeles. My family was poor, and there were times when we did not have a home. School became my way forward. I kept learning, and I went to college to study psychology.
slides.body_zh: 我在洛杉磯附近的康普頓長大。我家很窮，有一段時間我們甚至沒有家可以住。學校成了我往前走的路。我一直學下去，後來上了大學，讀心理學。

slides.q_en: Which word means “to bounce back after something hard”?
slides.q_zh: 哪個字的意思是「經歷困難之後重新站起來」？
slides.explain_en: Resilience! It is like a ball: the harder it hits the ground, the higher it can bounce.
slides.explain_zh: 韌性（resilience）！就像一顆球：落地落得越重，彈得越高。

stops.en: Racing on CBS's The Amazing Race
Running for the California State Assembly

slides.note_en: Every stop was a little scary. Every stop made me braver.
slides.note_zh: 每一站都有點可怕，每一站也都讓我更勇敢。

slides.head_en: the prize on The Amazing Race
slides.head_zh: 《驚險大挑戰》的獎金：一百萬美元
slides.body_en: In 2022, I raced on Season 34. Teams of two travel from country to country, solve puzzles, and meet people who speak other languages.
slides.body_zh: 2022 年，我參加了第 34 季。兩人一隊，一個國家接一個國家地跑，解謎題，遇見說不同語言的人。
slides.ask_en: If you could race through any three countries, which ones would you pick?
slides.ask_zh: 如果你可以跑過任何三個國家，你會選哪三個？

slides.head_zh: 2024 年，超過十萬人投票給 Dom
slides.body_en: In 2024, I ran for the California State Assembly. A kid from Compton asked a whole community to trust her, and more than 100,000 people said yes.
slides.body_zh: 2024 年，我參選加州州議會議員。一個在康普頓長大的孩子，請整個社區信任她，結果有超過十萬人投下了一票。
slides.ask_en: What is one thing you want to do that feels a little scary right now?
slides.ask_zh: 有沒有一件你想做、但現在覺得有點可怕的事？

slides.q_en: Dom speaks English, Vietnamese and Tagalog. Where is Tagalog mostly spoken?
slides.q_zh: Dom 會說英文、越南語和他加祿語。他加祿語主要在哪裡使用？
slides.explain_en: The Philippines! Many families in Taiwan have roots in Southeast Asia, and this fall your school is holding culture sessions on Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand and Cambodia.
slides.explain_zh: 菲律賓！台灣有很多家庭來自東南亞。這學期你們學校也在辦越南、印尼、泰國、柬埔寨的文化課程。

slides.body_en: A global mindset means being curious about the world, respecting people who are different, and being brave enough to connect. You do not need a passport to start. You can start right here in Tianzhong.
slides.body_zh: 國際觀就是對世界好奇、尊重和自己不一樣的人，而且有勇氣去連結。你不需要護照才能開始，在田中這裡就可以開始。

slides.body_en: In November, about 17,000 runners came to the Tianzhong Marathon. Fifty runners named Tanaka flew in from Japan, because 田中 is “Tanaka” in Japanese! And who won the cheering contest? Class 807!
slides.body_zh: 十一月，大約一萬七千名跑者來到田中馬拉松，其中有五十位姓「田中」的跑者從日本飛來，因為田中的日文就是 Tanaka！啦啦隊比賽冠軍是誰？807 班！

slides.q_en: Why did 50 runners from Japan come to the Tianzhong Marathon this year?
slides.q_zh: 今年為什麼有 50 位日本跑者來參加田中馬拉松？

options.en: Their family name is Tanaka (田中)

slides.explain_en: Tanaka is one of the most common family names in Japan. A town's name became a bridge between two countries!
slides.explain_zh: 田中是日本很常見的姓氏。一個小鎮的名字，變成了兩個國家之間的橋。

items.en: Asking a new classmate about their family's country
items.zh: 問新同學家人來自哪個國家

items.en: Laughing at someone's accent
items.zh: 笑別人的口音

items.en: Trying food from another culture
items.zh: 嘗試別的文化的食物

items.en: Never speaking English in case you make a mistake
items.zh: 怕說錯，所以從不說英文

items.en: Watching videos in English with subtitles
items.zh: 看有字幕的英文影片

items.en: Thinking “people like me can't go abroad”
items.zh: 覺得「像我這樣的人不可能出國」

slides.note_en: Thumbs up for OPEN, thumbs down for CLOSED!

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: You need to be rich to have a global mindset.
items.zh: 要有錢才能有國際觀。
items.note_zh: 好奇心和尊重，都不用錢。

items.en: Making mistakes is part of learning English.
items.zh: 犯錯是學英文的一部分。
items.note_en: Every fluent speaker made thousands of mistakes first.
items.note_zh: 每個說得流利的人，都先犯過幾千個錯。

items.en: Your hometown can be part of your global story.
items.zh: 你的家鄉可以是你國際故事的一部分。
items.note_en: Tianzhong already brings the world here: just ask the Tanakas!
items.note_zh: 田中早就把世界帶來了——問問那些田中先生就知道！

items.en: Your background decides your future.
items.zh: 你的背景決定你的未來。
items.note_en: It shapes you, but it does not decide for you.
items.note_zh: 背景會影響你，但不會替你做決定。

slides.body_en: At your school, old cans became homes for plants. One of them says “YOU ROCK! Be brave, little one.” Where you start does not decide how you grow.
slides.body_zh: 在你們學校，舊罐頭變成了植物的家，其中一個寫著「YOU ROCK! Be brave, little one」。你從哪裡開始，不決定你會長成什麼樣子。

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many dream jobs as you can, in English. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「夢想工作」越好，我來數！

slides.head_en: What Will Help Your Future Most?
slides.head_zh: 什麼對你的未來最有幫助？
slides.sub_en: Vote with your hands: 1, 2, 3, or 4 fingers.

items.en: Curiosity
items.zh: 好奇心

items.en: The courage to try
items.zh: 敢嘗試的勇氣

items.en: Speaking English
items.zh: 會說英文

items.en: Kindness
items.zh: 善良

slides.reveal_en: All four matter. My pick is #2: courage turns a dream into a first step.
slides.reveal_zh: 四個都重要。我選第 2 個：勇氣，能把夢想變成第一步。

slides.prompt_en: Where do you want to be in ten years? What is one step you can take this year?
slides.prompt_zh: 十年後，你想在哪裡？今年你可以踏出的一步是什麼？
slides.sentence_en: In ten years, I want to ______. This year, I will ______.
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask three of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請三位分享。

slides.head_en: A Note to My Future Self

lines.en: This year, I will be brave enough to ______.
My background is not my limit.
lines.zh: 我的背景，不是我的極限。

slides.tip_en: Write it on paper and keep it. Open it on the day you graduate from high school!
slides.tip_zh: 寫在紙上收好，高中畢業那天再打開！

slides.note_en: Watch, then tell me one way school can open a door for you.
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我學校可以幫你打開哪一扇門。

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do This Month
slides.head_zh: 這個月你可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Say one English sentence to a foreign teacher or visitor.
items.zh: 對外師或外國訪客說一句英文。

items.en: Learn one word in a classmate's family language.
items.zh: 學一個同學家鄉語言裡的字。

items.en: Write down one dream and one first step.
items.zh: 寫下一個夢想，和第一步。

items.en: My background is not my limit.
items.zh: 我的背景不是我的極限。

items.en: I can be brave.
items.zh: 我可以很勇敢。

items.en: Mistakes help me learn.
items.zh: 犯錯幫助我學習。

items.en: The world is bigger than my fears.
items.zh: 世界比我的害怕還要大。

items.en: My future starts today.
items.zh: 我的未來從今天開始。

slides.q_en: Dom's hometown, Huntington Beach, has a famous nickname. What is it?
slides.q_zh: Dom 的家鄉杭廷頓海灘有一個有名的綽號，是什麼？
slides.explain_en: Surf City USA! The Big Apple is New York, and the Windy City is Chicago. Rice City? That sounds like Tianzhong, Taiwan's rice granary!
slides.explain_zh: 美國衝浪之城！大蘋果是紐約，風城是芝加哥。稻米之城？聽起來比較像田中——台灣的米倉！

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Tianjhong Senior High column. No sign-up, no login: tell Dom one dream and one first step.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到田中高中那一欄，免註冊、免登入，告訴 Dom 你的一個夢想和第一步。
slides.sentence_en: My dream is ______, and my first step is ______.
slides.sentence_zh: 我的夢想是 ______，我的第一步是 ______。

slides.big_zh: 你的背景，不是你的極限。
